bullets.text: AI Revolutionising Telecoms - **Nvidia**'s report shows 90% of telcos see revenue boosts from AI investments.
D2D Services Under Scrutiny - Experts question the commercial viability of **D2D** connectivity despite growing interest.
Complexities of Open RAN - **Open RAN** deployment poses significant operational challenges for telecom operators.
Bipartisan Satellite Bill Approved - New legislation aims to expedite **FCC** satellite licensing processes.
5G Network Upgrade at Silverstone - **Boldyn** enhances connectivity at the iconic motorsport venue with 5G.
Optical Switching for Reliability - **Taara** targets carrier-grade uptime with innovative optical switching technology.
Data Breach at Odido - **Odido** confirms hack compromising data of 6.2 million customers.
Trusted Tech Alliance Formed - Major tech firms, including **Google** and **Ericsson**, unite for transparency in tech.
AI Driving 6G Planning - AI's influence reshapes future **6G** network designs to accommodate evolving demands.
AI to Surge WAN Traffic - **Nokia** forecasts a 700% increase in WAN traffic driven by AI by 2034.
